snippet.title: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 It’s here! 🎉
Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club is AVAILABLE NOW on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch & PC!

Take flight in the Sopwith Camel against the Red Baron 🛩️
Dodge disaster at the Kite-Eating Tree 🍃
Try to kick a football (good luck, Chuck!)
And dive into mystery-filled adventures with Snoopy and friends! 🔍

🐾 Suit up as Detective Snoopy and solve cases with classic charm and clever style.

🎬 Watch the official launch trailer and start your journey today!

#SnoopyMysteryClub #Snoopy #Peanuts #CharlieBrown #SnoopyLovers #MysteryGame

🎮 Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
🟦 PS5 | 🟩 Xbox | 🔴 Switch | 💻 PC
